### Connected by kindness

The Avery Dennison Foundation focuses on creating impact where it’s needed most. Through
grantmaking, we support a more thriving world. Watch our new video, illustrating how we foster a
more diverse and sustainable global community.

[Read more][157]

### Ready for what’s next. ReadyDPP™.

ReadyDPP is Avery Dennison’s integrated, full service solution that seamlessly creates and manages
Digital Product Passports. We reduce the complexity of compliance, giving you total control and
peace of mind to focus on whatever’s next for your brand.

[Learn more][158]

### Anti-dew protective overlay

Dew can cut sign reflectivity by 60% at night, risking safety. Avery Dennison OL-1200 clear overlay
film prevents dew droplets from forming, maintaining optimal visibility and sign reliability.

[Learn more][159]

### Connected by kindness

The Avery Dennison Foundation focuses on creating impact where it’s needed most. Through
grantmaking, we support a more thriving world. Watch our new video, illustrating how we foster a
more diverse and sustainable global community.

[Read more][157]

### Ready for what’s next. ReadyDPP™.

ReadyDPP is Avery Dennison’s integrated, full service solution that seamlessly creates and manages
Digital Product Passports. We reduce the complexity of compliance, giving you total control and
peace of mind to focus on whatever’s next for your brand.

[Learn more][158]

### Anti-dew protective overlay

Dew can cut sign reflectivity by 60% at night, risking safety. Avery Dennison OL-1200 clear overlay
film prevents dew droplets from forming, maintaining optimal visibility and sign reliability.

[Learn more][159]

thinner mono-material substrates with contrast and no risk of perforation.

DIGITAL LEARNING SOLUTIONS

Empower your production with Markem-Imaje Academy

Access a comprehensive e-learning platform designed to maximize uptime, improve efficiency, and get
the most from your Markem-Imaje solutions.

[Start learning todayarrow_forward][124]
[Discover the true value of innovation with the new 9712 Bi-Jet inkjet printer!]

CONTINUOUS INKJET PRINTING TECHNOLOGY

9712: Designed to MAX your coding experience!

Coding two times faster or printing twice the amount of data, the 9712’s compact print capacity and
Bi-Jet printhead features improve production line performance while still delivering excellent codes

[Discover 9712, Markem-Imaje's next generation Bi-Jet modelarrow_forward][125]
[SmartLase UV500: unmatched efficiency on highly demanding, ultra-fast coding applications.]

UV LASER MARKING TECHNOLOGY

SmartLase UV500: Unmatched efficiency for ultra-fast coding.

This 5-Watt UV laser coder meets the demand for a fast solution with minimal heat transfer, marking
thinner mono-material substrates with contrast and no risk of perforation.

[Discover nowarrow_forward][126]
[How to choose TTO printer vs. UV LASER coder]

NEW KNOWLEDGE ARTICLE

Thermal Transfer Overprinting (TTO) or Ultra-Violet (UV) Laser

Our article explains how future-proofing with the right technology can help your line remain
efficient, compliant, and adaptable in a rapidly changing market.

[Download nowarrow_forward][127]
[Discover the true value of innovation with the new 9750 Expert series!]

CONTINUOUS INKJET PRINTING TECHNOLOGY

9750 Expert Series: Tough applications. Expertly coded.

Designed to deliver excellent customizable and traceable codes in high speed, dusty and humid
environments − even on the most difficult materials.

[Discover nowarrow_forward][128]
[Introducing SmartLase® F250, our new fiber laser coder]

FIBER LASER MARKING TECHNOLOGY

SmartLase F250: Smart, safe and compact.

Power in a small package. The compact SmartLase F250 fiber laser marking solution delivers
high-quality, chemical-free, permanent coding as it lowers your operating expenses.

[Discover SmartLase® F250arrow_forward][129]

tracking and tracing across the supply chain.

enhancing user experience.

Acviss’s anti-counterfeiting solutions employing machine learning, computer vision, blockchain,
infrastructure and cryptography.

## World's Leading Anti-Counterfeit Technology

Built on real-time detection, global reach, and identity systems that scale with your brand.

### Global Reach

Acviss operates globally, assuring the safety of your products not only within your region but
across the world.

### Counterfeit Detection

Our unwavering commitment transcends mere counterfeit protection; we provide real-time counterfeit
identification and seamless reporting.

### Real-Time Protection

Real-time identification and the reporting of any counterfeiting encounter, safeguarding your
brand’s integrity within the supply chain.

### Unique Identity

Non-replicable identity for every product on a non-tamper, holographic label, enabling precise
tracking and tracing across the supply chain.

### Mobile Accessibility

Consumer-friendly mobile application, for quick and effortless product authenticity verification
enhancing user experience.

## Cutting-Edge Technology

Acviss’s anti-counterfeiting solutions employing machine learning, computer vision, blockchain,
infrastructure and cryptography.

## Across Industries, Around the Globe

### Automotive

Around 30-40% of auto components sold are fake. The automobile industry loses an estimated 30% of
its revenue due to Intellectual Property related crime.

### Agro Products

of the pesticides sold are counterfeit products.

### Pharmaceuticals

estimated to be $200 Billion in 2022.

Adaptive Recognition is the pioneering force in image processing technology, shaping the future of
smarter mobility and safer identity verification. Our suite of ANPR/LPR hardware and software and ID
& verification solutions optimise traffic flow, enhance access control, and secures identification. 

تُعد Adaptive Recognition قوة رائدة في تقنيات معالجة الصور، حيث تُسهم في تشكيل مستقبل التنقل الذكي
والتحقق الآمن من الهوية. تعمل حلولنا من الأجهزة والبرمجيات الخاصة بالتعرف على لوحات المركبات (التعرف
التلقائي على لوحات الأرقام / التعرف على لوحات الأرقام) وحلول قراءة الهوية والتحقق منها على تحسين حركة
المرور، وتعزيز التحكم في الوصول، وتأمين التعرف على الهويات.

Adaptive Recognition to pionier w technologii przetwarzania obrazu, kształtujący przyszłość
inteligentnej mobilności i bezpiecznej weryfikacji tożsamości. Nasze rozwiązania sprzętowe i
programowe do automatycznego rozpoznawania tablic rejestracyjnych (ANPR/LPR – automatyczne
rozpoznawanie tablic / odczyt tablic) oraz systemy odczytu i weryfikacji tożsamości usprawniają
przepływ ruchu, zwiększają kontrolę dostępu i zapewniają bezpieczną identyfikację.

Adaptive Recognition je priekopníckou silou v oblasti technológií spracovania obrazu, formujúcou
budúcnosť inteligentnej mobility a bezpečnej overovania identity. Naša ponuka hardvéru a softvéru
ANPR/LPR a riešení na overovanie ID optimalizuje tok dopravy, zlepšuje kontrolu prístupu a
zabezpečuje identifikáciu.

Az Adaptive Recognition úttörő szerepet tölt be a jármű- és okmányazonosítási technológiák
területén, támogatva a közlekedési folyamatok hatékony működését és a megbízható
személyazonosság-ellenőrzést. Rendszámfelismerő hardver- és szoftvermegoldásaink, valamint
okmányolvasási és ellenőrzési technológiáink optimalizálják a forgalmat, egyszerűsítik a
beléptetést, és gyors, pontos személyazonosítást tesznek lehetővé.

Adaptive Recognition is the pioneering force in image processing technology, shaping the future of
smarter mobility and safer identity verification. Our suite of ANPR/LPR hardware and software and ID
& verification solutions optimise traffic flow, enhance access control, and secures identification. 

تُعد Adaptive Recognition قوة رائدة في تقنيات معالجة الصور، حيث تُسهم في تشكيل مستقبل التنقل الذكي
والتحقق الآمن من الهوية. تعمل حلولنا من الأجهزة والبرمجيات الخاصة بالتعرف على لوحات المركبات (التعرف
التلقائي على لوحات الأرقام / التعرف على لوحات الأرقام) وحلول قراءة الهوية والتحقق منها على تحسين حركة
المرور، وتعزيز التحكم في الوصول، وتأمين التعرف على الهويات.

Adaptive Recognition to pionier w technologii przetwarzania obrazu, kształtujący przyszłość
inteligentnej mobilności i bezpiecznej weryfikacji tożsamości. Nasze rozwiązania sprzętowe i
programowe do automatycznego rozpoznawania tablic rejestracyjnych (ANPR/LPR – automatyczne
rozpoznawanie tablic / odczyt tablic) oraz systemy odczytu i weryfikacji tożsamości usprawniają
przepływ ruchu, zwiększają kontrolę dostępu i zapewniają bezpieczną identyfikację.

Adaptive Recognition je priekopníckou silou v oblasti technológií spracovania obrazu, formujúcou
budúcnosť inteligentnej mobility a bezpečnej overovania identity. Naša ponuka hardvéru a softvéru
ANPR/LPR a riešení na overovanie ID optimalizuje tok dopravy, zlepšuje kontrolu prístupu a
zabezpečuje identifikáciu.

Az Adaptive Recognition úttörő szerepet tölt be a jármű- és okmányazonosítási technológiák
területén, támogatva a közlekedési folyamatok hatékony működését és a megbízható
személyazonosság-ellenőrzést. Rendszámfelismerő hardver- és szoftvermegoldásaink, valamint
okmányolvasási és ellenőrzési technológiáink optimalizálják a forgalmat, egyszerűsítik a
beléptetést, és gyors, pontos személyazonosítást tesznek lehetővé.

Meet AeroFlexx

## Think outside the bottle.

We took the positive attributes of rigid and flexible packaging and eliminated the negatives to
create an entirely new form of liquid packaging. AeroFlexx is an all-in-one packaging solution that
can simplify your brand’s supply chain, can be curbside recyclable where all plastic bottles are
accepted, and deliver an enhanced dispensing experience. 

Our Packaging Technology

## Disrupting the liquid packaging industry.

At AeroFlexx, we've discovered a better way of packaging, shipping, and dispensing liquids. Built
with both brands and consumers in mind, our **innovative liquid packaging solution** is
revolutionizing the industry as we know it.

Transform consumers' routines into delights with a better dispensing experience for body washes,
shampoos, conditioners, and lotions.

dish soap, laundry care, and cleaning supplies.

Enjoy the little moments with a soft, lightweight, and squeezable design that reduces spills and
messes, letting you focus on your baby.

including shampoos and conditioners.

[ Learn More ][43]

messaging. Our liquid packaging comes in a variety of sizes and shapes to meet your product needs.

[ Learn More ][51]
Global Impact

## Protect the planet.

Accelerate progress toward your company's sustainability goals when you do the right thing for your
brand—and the planet.

[ Learn More ][52]
[Illustration of plastic bottle]
Reduce plastic at the source.

AeroFlexx Paks eliminate up to 85% of virgin plastic compared to traditional bottles. Our 16-ounce
stock package weighs only 14 grams.

[Illustration of arrows in a circle]
Shrink your carbon footprint.

Our streamlined shipping process means fewer trucks on the road, fewer gallons of gas, and a
reduction in CO2 emissions.

[Illustration of hand holding globe]
Scale for the future of sustainability.

We've simplified the supply chain process and removed unnecessary packaging materials to protect the
planet as you scale.

[For Brands][53] [For Consumers][54]

## Keep your brand future-focused.

[IMG_20210616_153848]
Manufacturing

## Durable packaging that's built to last.

Manufacture liquid packaging the right way with 50-70 percent less plastic. Traditional packaging
manufacturing relies on the use of molds, which are costly to maintain and expensive to change. Our
cutting-edge technology is **mold-free and tamper-proof** off the line, creating a smoother
manufacturing process and improving the bottom line.

[ Our Machines ][55]
[Two Aeroflexx Paks on counter top]
Branding

## Custom designs that stand out on shelves.

At AeroFlexx, our innovation transforms your packaging process from start to finish. We're giving
more power back to brands with 360-degree artwork so you can showcase your brand's unique style and
attract the attention of new consumers.

[ Our Branding Process ][56]
[Person holding an AeroFlexx Pak]
Shipping

## Faster shipping with fewer headaches.

We make shipping straightforward and hassle-free. Traditional bottles break or spill during
shipping. With AeroFlexx Paks, you and your customers get peace of mind with **mess-free shipping
**every time. Plus, our packs are Amazon ISTA 6 approved for SIOC and over boxing, so they ship
easily in an envelope and eliminate excessive packaging requirements.

[ Our Production Process ][57]
[Woman bathing a baby with an AeroFlexx Pak of baby soap]
Total Value

## Lasting results at a lower total cost.

Not only does our process get products to consumers faster but also at a lower total cost for
brands. Thanks to **streamlined manufacturing** and **sustainable shipping methods**, you can
deliver more inventory to more consumers at a fraction of the cost. 

[ Get Started ][58]

## Designed. Tested. Approved.

[Person squeezing chocolate syrup out of an AeroFlexx Pak onto an ice cream sundae]
Ease of Use

## Created for ultimate consumer satisfaction.

AeroFlexx Paks have been designed with your customers in mind. **Airframe technology** maintains the
pack's structural integrity throughout its entire lifecycle. Our one-step easy tear and self-sealing
valve offer open-and-close ease of use. Plus, our precision control allows consumers to dispense
liquid in small doses, drop by drop, for a simple, mess-free experience.

[ See Who We Help ][59]
[Green AeroFlexx Pak with dish soap]
Durability

## Mess-free from the first drop to the last.

Traditional bottles often spill or make messes during the shipping process, which in turn, leads to
customer dissatisfaction. AeroFlexx Paks, on the other hand, arrive in perfect condition, are
**mess-free, and remain leak-free**, even if they're dropped.

[Young girl squeezing condiment out of AeroFlexx Pak onto a burger]

As leaders in sustainable liquid packaging, we're disrupting the industry and changing the way

# ALPLA is a world leader in the development and production of innovative plastic packaging
# solutions.

We produce innovative packaging systems, bottles, caps and injection-moulded parts for a wide range
of industries since 1955. Our long history as a family-run business, our cutting-edge technologies
and the knowledge and dedication of our employees set us and our products apart. Our business
activities are founded on sustainability and the climate-friendly use of resources. With our more
than 30 years of experience in recycling and our own recycling plants, we play our part in ensuring
that plastics remain in the materials cycle.

# DISCOVER OUR COUNTERFEIT PROTECTION SOLUTIONS

We are the world’s leader in invisible digital technologies for counterfeit protection. Simple and
industry-proven, our cost-effective, high-security digital solutions to combat counterfeiters
protect billions of packages of branded products across industries worldwide, including in the areas
of pharmaceuticals, tobacco, spirits, lubricants, precious metals, and government. Counterfeit
detection is performed using a smartphone.

 

**Deciding how to employ counterfeit protection on your products can be a challenge, so we offer a
white paper to guide you through the process of selecting the technology that best suits your needs.
That may be our technology—indeed, we can ****check ****the authenticity of ****almost any product,
and, if yours presents a challenge, we can create custom solutions for you—but it may also be
another type of technology.**

 

# ONE MINUTE TO FIND YOUR OPTIMAL SECURITY FEATURE

Try our security feature selection tool! Answer a few questions and the tool will show you the most
appropriate solutions.

[OPEN the Selection Tool][48]

## COUNTERFEIT PROTECTION

[Counterfeit Protection - Home Page 2]
[Counterfeit Protection - Home Page 3]
[Counterfeit Protection - Home Page 4]
[Counterfeit Protection - Home Page 5]

### ANTI-COUNTERFEITING TECHNOLOGY WITH NO EXTRA PRODUCTION PROCESS

Counterfeiting is a scourge that equally affects products and documents. AlpVision
anti-counterfeiting technologies are covert, which means invisible to you, and highly secure.
Suitable for printed, machined and molded products, and even high-value documents, AlpVision
solutions are made to match your requirements.
Our counterfeit protection solutions are applied to over 30 billion branded products each year
across industries worldwide. Additionally, AlpVision protects millions of high-value documents from
forgery, tampering and counterfeiting. Our solution does not require special ink or paper nor any
change in the production process.

[FIND OUT MORE][49]

### ALPVISION’S COVERT ANTI-COUNTERFEITING

AlpVision provides covert as opposed to overt anti-counterfeiting technologies because they are
intrinsically more secure. Obviously, it is more difficult to counterfeit what cannot be seen.
Additionally, overt technologies are very difficult to abandon after they are adopted, as the
consumer expects to find them, and the verification of visible technologies relies entirely on user
skills, which are extremely variable. The most common drawback of covert technologies is that they
require a specific proprietary device to be detected. This is not the case with AlpVision
technologies, as detection is performed using a regular smartphone combined with an app. The
smartphone also collects valuable information about counterfeiting threats and technology use by
sending usage data to a central server for analysis.

The beauty of AlpVision’s anti-counterfeiting technology is that it also seamlessly applies a
digital protection layer to your track-and-trace system. This helps you determine when and where you
may have counterfeiting problems in your supply chain and makes possible the identification of [gray
market activities][50].

The following summary highlights the advantages of our solutions::
* They provide high security against the copying of genuine products
* Product verification is done with a mobile phone.
* Implementation is simple and inexpensive.
* Our technologies cannot be distinguished on original goods.
* They offer instant positive authentication.

[DISCOVER OUR ANTI-COUNTERFEITING TECHNOLOGY][51]

##### OTHER INDUSTRIES

At first glance, governments and the tobacco, lubricants, pharmaceutical, wine and spirits, and
precious metals industries may have little in common. For all of them, however, counterfeit
protection represents a challenge. Their markets are inundated by counterfeit goods and documents.

As our mission is to fight against counterfeiting, we are well aware of the various challenges faced
by those industries as described below:
* Pharmaceuticals: Fake medicines kill patients.
* Tobacco: One in 10 cigarettes is somehow related to illicit trade, and this will soon extend to
  e-cigarettes.
* Governments: In addition to being counterfeited, documents can also be forged and are vulnerable
  to tampering.
* Precious metals: Both fake ingots and ingots filled with tungsten are sold by counterfeiters.
* Wine and Spirits: Fake alcohols may contain toxic substances.
* Lubricants: The copying and dilution of lubricants can damage brands’ reputations.

These industries are not the only ones plagued by counterfeit items. The footwear industry, the
luxury goods industry (beset by fake handbags and replica watches), the electronic parts industry
(semiconductors), and many others can benefit from our counterfeit protection..

intrinsically more secure. Obviously, it is more difficult to counterfeit what cannot be seen.

skills, which are extremely variable. The most common drawback of covert technologies is that they
require a specific proprietary device to be detected. This is not the case with AlpVision

##### OTHER INDUSTRIES

At first glance, governments and the tobacco, lubricants, pharmaceutical, wine and spirits, and
precious metals industries may have little in common. For all of them, however, counterfeit
protection represents a challenge. Their markets are inundated by counterfeit goods and documents.

As our mission is to fight against counterfeiting, we are well aware of the various challenges faced
by those industries as described below:
* Pharmaceuticals: Fake medicines kill patients.
* Tobacco: One in 10 cigarettes is somehow related to illicit trade, and this will soon extend to
  e-cigarettes.
* Governments: In addition to being counterfeited, documents can also be forged and are vulnerable
  to tampering.
* Precious metals: Both fake ingots and ingots filled with tungsten are sold by counterfeiters.
* Wine and Spirits: Fake alcohols may contain toxic substances.
* Lubricants: The copying and dilution of lubricants can damage brands’ reputations.

These industries are not the only ones plagued by counterfeit items. The footwear industry, the
luxury goods industry (beset by fake handbags and replica watches), the electronic parts industry
(semiconductors), and many others can benefit from our counterfeit protection..

# System Integration & Cybersecurity for Modern Organizations

PT. Arahan Bahtera Teknologi membantu Anda mengintegrasikan infrastruktur TI dan mengamankan aset
digital—mulai dari desain arsitektur, implementasi, hingga operasi keamanan. Secure your own future.

[ Konsultasi ][7] [ Lihat Layanan ][8]

## About Us

### Who We Are

PT. Arahan Bahtera Teknologi adalah perusahaan **System Integrator** dan **Cybersecurity Services**
yang membantu organisasi merancang, mengintegrasikan, dan mengamankan ekosistem TI. Kami
menggabungkan keahlian infrastruktur (network, server, cloud) dengan praktik keamanan (assessment,
hardening, monitoring, incident response) agar sistem berjalan **stabil**, **terukur**, dan
**aman**.

Fokus kami adalah kemitraan jangka panjang: dari konsultasi, implementasi, hingga layanan terkelola.

System Integration
Network & Infrastructure
Security Assessment
Managed Security

## Our Services

Layanan System Integrator & Cybersecurity yang siap disesuaikan dengan kebutuhan organisasi Anda.

## Our Partners

Kami berkolaborasi dengan partner teknologi untuk menghadirkan solusi System Integrator &

# About Colbert Packaging

Colbert Packaging is a dynamic high volume producer of sustainable paper-based packaging, serving
the pharmaceutical, healthcare and consumer goods industries. We produce offset and flexographic
printed folding cartons, formed paper trays, pressure-sensitive roll labels and informational
package inserts. Our in-house services include structural design, full-service prepress, paperboard
sheeting, ink blending/matching and die making/cutting.

We’ll work with you to design earth-friendly, secondary packaging solutions that satisfy today’s
sustainability requirements. Everything from right-sizing materials to 100% inline vision inspection
for fully integrated quality control, sets you on a course to ***The Total Package***. Add to the
equation fully recyclable paperboard, along with water- and agri-based inks, coatings and adhesives,
and you’ll have The Total Package in **[One Clean Carton®!][53]**

Is product tampering or counterfeiting a concern? We offer a complete array of overt and covert
security features designed to guard against fraud risks. Take a few minutes to learn more about our
[**Anti-Counterfeit Solutions**][54].

### Our History of Growth and Innovation since 1959

#### We’ve got you covered!

We’re an independent, woman-owned small business, based in the Midwest for more than sixty-five
years. Colbert Packaging employees are trustworthy and known for their strong work ethic, along with
a passion for supporting our customers with safe, smart and sustainable packaging.

|

# About Colbert Packaging

Colbert Packaging is a dynamic high volume producer of sustainable paper-based packaging, serving
the pharmaceutical, healthcare and consumer goods industries. We produce offset and flexographic
printed folding cartons, formed paper trays, pressure-sensitive roll labels and informational
package inserts. Our in-house services include structural design, full-service prepress, paperboard
sheeting, ink blending/matching and die making/cutting.

We’ll work with you to design earth-friendly, secondary packaging solutions that satisfy today’s
sustainability requirements. Everything from right-sizing materials to 100% inline vision inspection
for fully integrated quality control, sets you on a course to ***The Total Package***. Add to the
equation fully recyclable paperboard, along with water- and agri-based inks, coatings and adhesives,
and you’ll have The Total Package in **[One Clean Carton®!][53]**

Is product tampering or counterfeiting a concern? We offer a complete array of overt and covert
security features designed to guard against fraud risks. Take a few minutes to learn more about our
[**Anti-Counterfeit Solutions**][54].

### Our History of Growth and Innovation since 1959

#### We’ve got you covered!

We’re an independent, woman-owned small business, based in the Midwest for more than sixty-five
years. Colbert Packaging employees are trustworthy and known for their strong work ethic, along with
a passion for supporting our customers with safe, smart and sustainable packaging.

|

### “What packaging challenges are you up against? Our solutions put your product first.”

– Ryan Hart, VP Sales & Marketing

For product marketers, Colbert Packaging applies industry heritage,

## What Is Active Anti-Counterfeiting?

Active anti-counterfeiting is an innovative and effective high-tech solution that helps businesses
and consumers quickly and easily detect counterfeit products.

Cypheme leverages a proprietary and reliable AI system for its unique anti-counterfeiting solution,
blending machine learning with physical signatures. This combination creates an identifier that’s
impossible to duplicate. Anyone scanning this unique label can verify whether a product is genuine
or fake. All they need is a smartphone camera to access our active anti-counterfeiting technology.

### Frequently Asked Questions about Cypheme’s active anti-counterfeiting technology

Can I reuse a Noise Print label?

No, Noise Print labels aren’t reusable because each one is a unique fingerprint that represents and
safeguards a specific item.

Where to place Noise Print labels?

For most retail products, it’s best to place Noise Print labels on the exterior packaging of your
products so consumers can scan them and authenticate each item before making a purchase. For
[authentication of collectibles and artwork][60], it is sometimes better to place Noise Print labels
on an outer casing or a certificate.

Do consumers need to download an application to verify products?

No. Consumers don’t need to install any application. Cypheme’s product verification uses a fully
web-based experience that functions directly through a smartphone camera and Internet connection.
Users simply capture an image of the Noise Print label and receive an authenticity result within
five seconds.

### Frequently Asked Questions about Cypheme’s active anti-counterfeiting technology

Can I reuse a Noise Print label?

No, Noise Print labels aren’t reusable because each one is a unique fingerprint that represents and
safeguards a specific item.

Where to place Noise Print labels?

For most retail products, it’s best to place Noise Print labels on the exterior packaging of your
products so consumers can scan them and authenticate each item before making a purchase. For
[authentication of collectibles and artwork][60], it is sometimes better to place Noise Print labels
on an outer casing or a certificate.

Do consumers need to download an application to verify products?

No. Consumers don’t need to install any application. Cypheme’s product verification uses a fully
web-based experience that functions directly through a smartphone camera and Internet connection.
Users simply capture an image of the Noise Print label and receive an authenticity result within
five seconds.

# Growth Through Strategic Investments

### At DSS Inc, we're building a dynamic portfolio of businesses across select strategic verticals
### leveraging our expertise in business harmonization.

[Learn More ][8]

## Our Approach to GROWTH

We invest in businesses that align with our core strengths, focusing on sectors including:
* Consumer Packaging
* Consumer Products
* Wealth Management
* Investment Securities
* Biohealth

 

By leveraging our foundational businesses, we create synergies that fuel long-term success. Our
approach is not just about acquisition—it’s about transformation. We strategically develop each
asset, integrate complementary capabilities, and position companies for sustainable growth, whether
through internal scaling or strategic partnerships.

### Operational Development

We take an active role in shaping each company’s growth—offering strategic guidance, operational
expertise, and capital planning to accelerate scale and unlock long-term potential.

### Experienced Leadership

We acquire and develop companies in sectors where our executive leadership and board members bring
significant knowledge and experience.

### Value Creation

We cultivate each business into a high-performing, independent enterprise—often unlocking value
through public offerings, strategic partnerships, or other transformative growth events

### Strategic Acquisitions

We target companies adjacent to our existing portfolio where we can apply our strengths and
experience

## Business Units

Our business units include companies across various high-profit sectors. We bring exceptional
service, expert leadership as well as creative, flexible solutions to all of our acquisitions.

# HOLO SOLUTION INC.

# Leader in Anti-Counterfeiting Technology &  Specialty Printing

[HOLO SOLUTION INC.]

Founded in Taiwan in 2002, Holo Solution began in Changhua and has since expanded with service
offices in New Taipei and Taichung. By continuously investing in advanced specialty printing
equipment and a fully integrated production system, we are committed to creating world-class
security printing technologies from Taiwan for the global market.

Guided by our core values of Integrity, Fairness, Trust, and Commitment, Holo Solution has
established itself as a trusted guardian of product authenticity. Our solutions include hologram
security labels, tamper-evident labels, security documents, value documents, specialty printing, and
cloud-based authentication platforms, serving customers across a wide range of industries.

In 2018, we launched OBASSO, a creative brand that brings security printing technologies into visual
design applications. From digital foil stamping and thermochromic printing to water-activated
interactive prints, we continue to push the boundaries of specialty printing, transforming security
technologies into creative experiences that add value to brands and printed products.

# HOLO SOLUTION INC.

# Leader in Anti-Counterfeiting Technology &  Specialty Printing

[HOLO SOLUTION INC.]

Founded in Taiwan in 2002, Holo Solution began in Changhua and has since expanded with service
offices in New Taipei and Taichung. By continuously investing in advanced specialty printing
equipment and a fully integrated production system, we are committed to creating world-class
security printing technologies from Taiwan for the global market.

Guided by our core values of Integrity, Fairness, Trust, and Commitment, Holo Solution has
established itself as a trusted guardian of product authenticity. Our solutions include hologram
security labels, tamper-evident labels, security documents, value documents, specialty printing, and
cloud-based authentication platforms, serving customers across a wide range of industries.

In 2018, we launched OBASSO, a creative brand that brings security printing technologies into visual
design applications. From digital foil stamping and thermochromic printing to water-activated
interactive prints, we continue to push the boundaries of specialty printing, transforming security
technologies into creative experiences that add value to brands and printed products.

## The True Cost of Internet Plans: What Providers Don't Advertise

Internet plans vary widely in what they include. Some providers advertise low introductory prices
that increase after 12 months. Others bundle equipment rental fees, data caps, or installation
charges that inflate the real cost. Our comparison engine calculates the true monthly cost of each
plan, factoring in promotional pricing expirations, equipment fees, and data overage charges, so you
see the complete picture before you sign up.

For example, a plan advertised at $49.99 per month may cost $75+ after the promotional period ends
and equipment fees are added. Many Americans have access to three or more internet providers, yet
most households never compare their options. According to FCC data, over 90% of U.S. households can
access broadband internet from at least two providers, and competition drives better pricing. By
taking just a few minutes to compare the true cost of internet plans, you could save $20 to $50 per
month or discover faster plans at your current price point.

[Compare Internet Providers][61]

## Home Internet Service: How to Choose the Right Plan

Home internet is a necessity for modern life, powering everything from streaming and remote work to
smart home devices and online education. The right home internet service depends on how many people
are in your household, what you use the internet for, and what providers are available at your
address. Here is a quick guide to help you choose the best internet for home use.

### Internet Speed Recommendations

50-100 Mbps

1-2 people, basic browsing | $30-45/mo

200-400 Mbps

3-4 people, streaming & remote work | $45-65/mo

500 Mbps-1 Gbps

5+ people, gaming & 4K streaming | $60-90/mo

1-5 Gbps

Power users & home offices | $80-180/mo

### Internet Connection Types

[

Fiber Internet

Fastest speeds (up to 10 Gbps), lowest latency, symmetric upload/download

][62][

Cable Internet

Widely available, speeds up to 1-2 Gbps, uses coaxial TV cables

][63][

5G Wireless Internet

No installation needed, speeds up to 300 Mbps, growing coverage

][64][

Satellite Internet

Available everywhere, best for rural areas, higher latency

][65]

## Wireless Internet Service Providers & 5G Home Internet

Wireless internet service has become a serious alternative to traditional wired connections. 5G home
internet from providers like T-Mobile and Verizon delivers download speeds of 100-300 Mbps without
the need for cable installation. Fixed wireless internet from providers like Rise Broadband and
Starlink serves millions of customers in areas where fiber and cable are not available.

The key advantages of wireless internet services include quick setup (often same-day), no long-term
contracts with most providers, and competitive pricing starting around $25-50 per month. The main
considerations are coverage and signal strength, as wireless performance depends on your distance
from the nearest tower or satellite. WiFi internet service quality can also vary depending on
network congestion in your area. Our availability checker shows which wireless internet service

## Business Internet: Plans for Small and Medium Businesses

Business internet requires higher reliability, faster upload speeds, and dedicated support compared
to residential plans. Most major internet companies offer business-grade plans with service level
agreements (SLAs), static IP addresses, and priority customer support. Business internet plans
typically start at $50-75 per month for basic connectivity and scale up to $200+ per month for
dedicated fiber connections.

For small businesses, the most important factors are upload speed (critical for video conferencing,
cloud backups, and hosting), reliability (downtime costs money), and scalability (as your business
grows, your internet should grow with it). Fiber internet providers generally offer the best
business plans because of symmetric upload and download speeds, but cable and fixed wireless options
can work well for businesses with moderate bandwidth needs.

## Internet Plans: What to Look for in 2026

The internet plan landscape in 2026 offers more choices and better value than ever. With increasing
competition between fiber, cable, and wireless internet providers, consumers benefit from lower
prices, faster speeds, and more flexible contract terms. When evaluating internet plans, focus on
these key factors:

### Download Speed

Look for plans offering at least 100 Mbps for streaming households. Fiber plans can deliver 1-10
Gbps.

### Upload Speed

Critical for video calls and cloud storage. Fiber offers symmetric speeds; cable typically offers
10-35 Mbps upload.

### Monthly Price

Compare the price after promotional periods end. Ask about the regular rate before signing up.

### Data Caps

Some providers limit monthly data to 1-1.25 TB. Heavy users should look for unlimited data plans.

### Contract Terms

Many providers now offer month-to-month plans. Watch for early termination fees on contract plans.

### Equipment Fees

Router/modem rental adds $10-15/mo. Buying your own equipment saves $120-180 per year.

## The True Cost of Internet Plans: What Providers Don't Advertise

Internet plans vary widely in what they include. Some providers advertise low introductory prices
that increase after 12 months. Others bundle equipment rental fees, data caps, or installation
charges that inflate the real cost. Our comparison engine calculates the true monthly cost of each
plan, factoring in promotional pricing expirations, equipment fees, and data overage charges, so you
see the complete picture before you sign up.

For example, a plan advertised at $49.99 per month may cost $75+ after the promotional period ends
and equipment fees are added. Many Americans have access to three or more internet providers, yet
most households never compare their options. According to FCC data, over 90% of U.S. households can
access broadband internet from at least two providers, and competition drives better pricing. By
taking just a few minutes to compare the true cost of internet plans, you could save $20 to $50 per
month or discover faster plans at your current price point.

review.

costs are locked.

### Third-party QC perspective

QC checkpoints are reviewed from the buyer project brief, not only from the production line's
internal view.

We separate pouch cost, setup, sample/proof, QC, documentation, and shipping coordination so quotes
are easier to compare.

Buyer inputs, required files, target market, and proof expectations are clarified before the brief
moves into quotation.

What kind of networking and content delivery solutions does Orient Technologies Limited offer?

Orient Technologies Limited offers a range of networking and content delivery network solutions.

What industries do you cater to?

We provide Cloud services to a wide range of industries, including Pharmaceutical, Healthcare, BFSI,
ITeS, Government-PSU and more.

How can a company prepare for cloud to cloud migration?

A company can prepare for cloud to cloud migration by performing a comprehensive inventory of its
current infrastructure, data, and applications, identifying potential compatibility issues or data
migration challenges, selecting a compatible cloud provider, and developing a migration plan that
includes testing and risk management measures

How can a company ensure data security during cloud to cloud migration?

A company can ensure data security during cloud to cloud migration by using encryption and secure
transfer protocols, implementing access controls and user authentication measures, and performing
regular security audits and risk assessments.

How can Orient Technologies Limited help us migrate our existing applications and data to the cloud?

Our team of experts can assist you with the planning, execution, and testing of your migration to
the cloud. We also offer automated tools and services to help you migrate your applications and data
quickly and efficiently.

What sets your cybersecurity solutions apart from competitors?

Full-spectrum Cybersecurity Solutions - From Cybersecurity Awareness, endpoint security to Cloud
Security and everything in between, Proactive threat intelligence, reducing vulnerabilities before
they escalate, Customizable security layers based on your unique business needs, Strategic
consulting through vCISO services, ensuring leadership-driven security frameworks, Cost-effective
scalability, offering enterprise-level security to businesses of all sizes.

What’s the ROI of investing in cybersecurity with Cyber Solutions?

Businesses that invest in proactive cybersecurity measures reduce breach costs by an average of 70%.

What industries benefit the most from your cybersecurity solutions?

Healthcare (PHI - protecting personal health information), Finance (Aligning with regulatory
compliances; safeguarding critical information assets), Retail & E-commerce (preventing data theft
and securing payment systems), Technology (safeguarding intellectual property), SMBs and enterprises
facing evolving digital threats.

How do your solutions ensure compliance with regulations like GDPR, HIPAA, or PCI DSS?

Our solutions are designed with compliance at their core. We offer frameworks and automated tools to
ensure your security practices align with industry regulations, minimizing risk and preventing
costly breaches.

How do you protect remote workforces and endpoints?

Through advanced Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR) solutions, we secure devices across remote
environments.

How do I know which cybersecurity service is right for my business?

We offer a cyber risk assessment and an initial consultation to evaluate your current security
posture.

Can your solutions integrate with our existing security infrastructure?

Yes! Our services are designed to integrate seamlessly with your existing technology stack.

# Preemptive exposure management

Whether you follow CTEM, Zero Trust, or your own framework, RedSeal’s AI-enabled exposure management
platform gives you the clarity and context to reduce risk faster — across
IT (on-prem, cloud, remote workers), OT, and IoT environments.

[ Schedule a Demo ][41]
[ LEARN MORE ABOUT CTEM ][42]

## Know your hybrid environment better than any adversary.

RedSeal delivers AI-enabled cyber terrain visibility and actionable insights to close security and
compliance gaps across your entire hybrid and remote environment. From hidden assets and
misconfigurations to exploitable attack paths, you’ll know exactly what matters most — and how to
address it.

### Hybrid Environment Modeling

Replace static diagrams and fragmented tools with a living, unified model of your entire environment
— complete, accurate, and continuously updated. See every asset, connection, and control, including
the ones other tools miss.

### Attack Path Analysis

Understand every possible way threats could move through your environment — before they strike.
Strengthen defenses and stop lateral movement by fixing exploitable gaps in advance.

### Risk Prioritization

Focus remediation where it reduces the most risk. RedSeal Risk Radius™ combines exploitability with
business impact to identify the exposures that truly matter — backed by transparent scoring, clear
evidence, and visual workflows that show why they’re prioritized.

### Continuous Compliance

Stay audit-ready every day, not just at audit time. RedSeal automatically validates your environment
against internal policies and standards like NIST, PCI DSS, CMMC, and CIS, with proof-ready reports.

RedSeal recognized in inaugural 2025 Gartner^{®} Magic Quadrant for Exposure Assessment Platforms

[ Download Now ][43]

## Preemptive exposure management with RedSeal

Our AI-enabled exposure management platform, powered by its automated workflow engine, gives you
complete visibility into how threats can actually move through your hybrid environment, which
exposures matter most to your business, and proof that your controls are working as intended.

[ Watch the Video ][44]

## Protecting the world.

Trusted by five branches of the US military, the world’s most trusted financial institutions, and
global disruptors.

“We are overwhelmed with data and underwhelmed by information. RedSeal allows us to prioritize with
actionable intelligence and stop playing whack-a-mole.”

Defense Agency
DoD Customer

“We needed a tool that on day one, could map the network and figure out the high-value assets while
finding and prioritizing vulnerabilities.”

“Through RedSeal, we were able to reduce the time it takes to evaluate our systems for specific

# Preemptive exposure management

Whether you follow CTEM, Zero Trust, or your own framework, RedSeal’s AI-enabled exposure management
platform gives you the clarity and context to reduce risk faster — across
IT (on-prem, cloud, remote workers), OT, and IoT environments.

## Know your hybrid environment better than any adversary.

RedSeal delivers AI-enabled cyber terrain visibility and actionable insights to close security and
compliance gaps across your entire hybrid and remote environment. From hidden assets and
misconfigurations to exploitable attack paths, you’ll know exactly what matters most — and how to
address it.

### Hybrid Environment Modeling

Replace static diagrams and fragmented tools with a living, unified model of your entire environment
— complete, accurate, and continuously updated. See every asset, connection, and control, including
the ones other tools miss.

### Attack Path Analysis

Understand every possible way threats could move through your environment — before they strike.
Strengthen defenses and stop lateral movement by fixing exploitable gaps in advance.

### Risk Prioritization

Focus remediation where it reduces the most risk. RedSeal Risk Radius™ combines exploitability with
business impact to identify the exposures that truly matter — backed by transparent scoring, clear
evidence, and visual workflows that show why they’re prioritized.

### Continuous Compliance

Stay audit-ready every day, not just at audit time. RedSeal automatically validates your environment
against internal policies and standards like NIST, PCI DSS, CMMC, and CIS, with proof-ready reports.

RedSeal recognized in inaugural 2025 Gartner^{®} Magic Quadrant for Exposure Assessment Platforms

## Decision Over Chaos

Embracing Agentic AI

Security teams are drowning in alerts while attackers move faster than ever. Securonix Unified
Defense SIEM uses an Agentic Mesh of specialized AI agents to help teams decide and act across the
threat lifecycle with speed, context, and control.
* Unified detection and response across data sources
* AI-driven anomaly detection with context
* Pre-built content and playbooks

**
The Result:** Security teams improve response times by up to 60 percent.


[SEE HOW][162]

## Alerts to Action

Evolving to the Agentic SOC

Traditional SIEMs generate volume. Modern security demands outcomes. As threats grow more complex,
teams need systems that reason, prioritize, and guide response in real time.

Powered by an Agentic Mesh, Securonix coordinates AI agents across detection, investigation, and
response to turn signals into guided decisions with human oversight.

With Securonix:
* Reduce alert noise and surface validated risk
* Accelerate investigations with contextual guidance
* Strengthen breach readiness across the environment
* Elevate SOC Analysts from Level 1 to Level 2

[SEE HOW][163]

## Productivity Instead of Noise

The AI SOC Analyst

Sam, the AI SOC Analyst, operates across the Unified Defense platform, analyzing behavior,
understanding context, and recommending actions across detection, investigation, and response.
Always learning. Always accountable. Always human-guided.

With Sam:
* Automated alert triage and prioritization
* Contextual enrichment using identity, behavior, and threat intelligence
* Investigation summaries that eliminate manual pivoting
* Case preparation for escalation and response
* Executive- and board-ready security summaries


[MEET SAM][164]

## Unified Defense SIEM’s Powerful Features

Securonix unifies analytics, threat intelligence, investigation, and response into a single
cloud-native platform designed for scale, precision, and speed. The Agentic Mesh orchestrates these
capabilities as one coordinated system.

## Threat Intelligence That Drives Action

Threat intelligence only matters when it improves decisions. Securonix transforms intelligence into
operational context by enriching detections, prioritizing risk, and guiding response across your
environment.
* Native intelligence ingestion and enrichment
* MITRE ATT&CK aligned context
* Integrated ThreatQ capabilities

[LEARN MORE][165]

## Less reporting. More investigation.

ThreatQ, now part of Securonix, brings curated threat intelligence into the Securonix security
operations portfolio. It centralizes, enriches, and prioritizes intelligence from internal and
external sources so teams can improve detection quality, accelerate investigations, and respond with
stronger context.

With ThreatQ, teams can:
* Unify threat intelligence across SOC, CTI, and IR workflows
* Enrich and prioritize indicators with relevant context
* Operationalize intelligence across SIEM, SOAR, EDR/XDR, and firewalls
* Strengthen Securonix AI-driven detection and response


[SEE HOW][166]

## Trusted by Global Security Leaders

Evolving to the Agentic SOC

Enterprises and MSSPs rely on Securonix to modernize security operations, reduce operational risk,
and move from reactive response to proactive, intelligence-driven defense. And there’s a reason for
that:

**Six-Time Consecutive Leader in the Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for SIEM**
Consistently recognized for completeness of vision and ability to execute, reflecting sustained
innovation, architectural strength, and customer trust.

**Two-Time Customers’ Choice on Gartner Peer Insights™**
Validated directly by security practitioners for product capabilities, deployment experience, and

Together, these recognitions reflect both strategic leadership and real-world impact for Enterprises
and MSSPs.

WE PROTECT GREAT COMPANIES AND THEIR PEOPLE

Your organization is unique. But all too often, cost concerns force mid-market companies to settle
for cookie cutter solutions. Silent Sector provides unbiased vendor and technology-neutral
cybersecurity assessments, guidance, managed cybersecurity services, and program implementation to
keep your company compliant and ahead of the threats. We design solutions for mid-market and
emerging companies in the healthcare, financial services, technology, education, manufacturing, and
defense industries.

### Expertise Impact Methodology

Our experts become an extension of your organization

Silent Sector's unique Expertise Impact Model™ streamlines cost and response time by putting you in
direct contact with the experts you need.  Using an asymmetrical warfare approach based on US Army

external resources.  This force multiplication methodology also focuses on getting the most value
from your existing software and hardware.  It’s how Silent Sector delivers the high level of
proficiency typically only available to large enterprises, right-sized for the budgets of mid-market
and emerging organizations who need it most.

# Advanced Materials

### Experience. Transformation.

Beginning with the inspiring legacy of Lorilleux and Samuel Morrill in the early 1800’s, Sun
Chemical has delivered [over 200 years][114] of color expertise, innovative technology and an
ongoing commitment to quality and service for our customers.

A member of the DIC Group, Sun Chemical is a leading producer of packaging and graphic solutions,
color and display technologies, functional products, electronic materials, and products for the
automotive and healthcare industries.

Together with DIC, Sun Chemical’s 21,000+ employees are continuously working to promote and develop
sustainable solutions to exceed customer expectations and better the world around us. Spread across
17 [research and development][115] centers worldwide, we’ve been granted over 3,000 patents and are
determined to deliver the solutions you need.


## Sun Chemical's Products and Solutions

#### [ Packaging and Graphic Solutions ][116]

Sun Chemical is a recognized leader in[ printing inks, coatings, adhesives and supplies][117] for
the packaging, publication, commercial, industrial, and digital markets and introduces solutions
that enable marketers to better manage their brand colors, protect product integrity through
improvements in packaging, and introduce security features that defend against counterfeiting.

#### [ Color Materials ][118]

Sun Chemical develops a wide range of [pigments and color materials][119] for architectural,
automotive and industrial coatings, cosmetics, plastics, printing inks, agricultural, and more.
Combining its pigments with DIC’s polymers for the same industries can create superior benefits and
value for coatings formulators.

#### [ Advanced Materials ][120]

Sun Chemical and DIC produce a variety of [advanced materials][121], including liquid compounds,
solid compounds and application materials for printed circuits, printed electronics, solar modules,
digital inkjet printing, automotive components, adhesives, magnetic tapes for plastic cards and
degasification modules.

#### [ Sun Chemical Security ][122]

[Sun Chemical Security][123] is our dedicated global security solutions business unit focused on
providing a wide-range of high-quality security solutions to help protect your products from
counterfeiters.

## Sun Chemical's Unwavering Focus on Sustainability

#### Learn How Sun Chemical is Prioritizing Sustainability

Sun Chemical is constantly working to promote sustainable solutions. [Our approach][124] to
sustainability guides the way we develop, manufacture and distribute products, as well as how we
work with our customers and suppliers.

Working with industry leaders and in line with DIC Corporation’s goal to achieve [carbon neutrality
by 2050][125], we are reducing global CO2 emissions by increasing the use of bio-renewable and
recyclable materials, while promoting the value of these activities throughout the supply chain. Our
emphasis on sustainability continues to be fundamental to our innovation and product development and
is gaining broad support from our customers.

[ [SunChemical-Sustainability-Report-Covers] ][126]

#### [ Download Our Latest Sustainability Report ][127]

Every year we publish a [sustainability report][128] which shows our progress in achieving our
eco-efficiency goals and helps us establish actions to improve, recheck and remeasure.

[ [coffee-flexible-packaging-transforms-into-owl] ][129]

#### [ Experience. Transformation. ][130]

As the [packaging market transforms][131] its packaging toward sustainability, use our 200+ years of
experience to help your packaging become bio-renewable, compostable or recyclable.

[ [Sustainable-Growth-Guide-Cover] ][132]

#### [ Sustainable Growth with the "5Rs" ][133]

Sun Chemical has produced *[Sustainable Growth][134] *– a guide to help you grow your business
sustainably and contribute to the circular economy. The guide is centered around five “Rs” — Reuse,
Reduce, Renew, Recycle, and Redesign. 

## Explore Career Opportunities at Sun Chemical

Looking for a fulfilling career with Sun Chemical? Take a look at the [career opportunities][135]
available to you and get a feel for what it’s like working at Sun Chemical.
[#lifeatsunchemical][136]

Have questions or comments about our products, services, safety data sheets (SDS / MSDS) or product
data sheets (TDS)? Get in touch!

# Sun Chemical is the World’s Leading Provider of Inks and Pressroom Products, Color Materials and
# Advanced Materials

### Experience. Transformation.

Beginning with the inspiring legacy of Lorilleux and Samuel Morrill in the early 1800’s, Sun
Chemical has delivered [over 200 years][114] of color expertise, innovative technology and an
ongoing commitment to quality and service for our customers.

A member of the DIC Group, Sun Chemical is a leading producer of packaging and graphic solutions,
color and display technologies, functional products, electronic materials, and products for the
automotive and healthcare industries.

Together with DIC, Sun Chemical’s 21,000+ employees are continuously working to promote and develop
sustainable solutions to exceed customer expectations and better the world around us. Spread across
17 [research and development][115] centers worldwide, we’ve been granted over 3,000 patents and are
determined to deliver the solutions you need.


## Sun Chemical's Products and Solutions

#### [ Packaging and Graphic Solutions ][116]

Sun Chemical is a recognized leader in[ printing inks, coatings, adhesives and supplies][117] for
the packaging, publication, commercial, industrial, and digital markets and introduces solutions
that enable marketers to better manage their brand colors, protect product integrity through
improvements in packaging, and introduce security features that defend against counterfeiting.

#### [ Color Materials ][118]

Sun Chemical develops a wide range of [pigments and color materials][119] for architectural,
automotive and industrial coatings, cosmetics, plastics, printing inks, agricultural, and more.
Combining its pigments with DIC’s polymers for the same industries can create superior benefits and
value for coatings formulators.

#### [ Advanced Materials ][120]

Sun Chemical and DIC produce a variety of [advanced materials][121], including liquid compounds,
solid compounds and application materials for printed circuits, printed electronics, solar modules,
digital inkjet printing, automotive components, adhesives, magnetic tapes for plastic cards and
degasification modules.

#### [ Sun Chemical Security ][122]

[Sun Chemical Security][123] is our dedicated global security solutions business unit focused on
providing a wide-range of high-quality security solutions to help protect your products from
counterfeiters.

## Sun Chemical's Unwavering Focus on Sustainability

#### Learn How Sun Chemical is Prioritizing Sustainability

Sun Chemical is constantly working to promote sustainable solutions. [Our approach][124] to
sustainability guides the way we develop, manufacture and distribute products, as well as how we
work with our customers and suppliers.

Working with industry leaders and in line with DIC Corporation’s goal to achieve [carbon neutrality
by 2050][125], we are reducing global CO2 emissions by increasing the use of bio-renewable and
recyclable materials, while promoting the value of these activities throughout the supply chain. Our
emphasis on sustainability continues to be fundamental to our innovation and product development and
is gaining broad support from our customers.

[ [SunChemical-Sustainability-Report-Covers] ][126]

#### [ Download Our Latest Sustainability Report ][127]

Every year we publish a [sustainability report][128] which shows our progress in achieving our
eco-efficiency goals and helps us establish actions to improve, recheck and remeasure.

[ [coffee-flexible-packaging-transforms-into-owl] ][129]

#### [ Experience. Transformation. ][130]

As the [packaging market transforms][131] its packaging toward sustainability, use our 200+ years of
experience to help your packaging become bio-renewable, compostable or recyclable.

[ [Sustainable-Growth-Guide-Cover] ][132]

#### [ Sustainable Growth with the "5Rs" ][133]

Sun Chemical has produced *[Sustainable Growth][134] *– a guide to help you grow your business
sustainably and contribute to the circular economy. The guide is centered around five “Rs” — Reuse,
Reduce, Renew, Recycle, and Redesign. 

## Explore Career Opportunities at Sun Chemical

Looking for a fulfilling career with Sun Chemical? Take a look at the [career opportunities][135]
available to you and get a feel for what it’s like working at Sun Chemical.

Have questions or comments about our products, services, safety data sheets (SDS / MSDS) or product
data sheets (TDS)? Get in touch!

# Smooth. Smart. Supported.

Take your ice cream production further – from early ideas to reliable, day-to-day operations. Move
with confidence and keep consumers coming back for more.
[ Learn more⁠ ][173]

## Featured

### How we can help you

Delivering food processing and packaging solutions and support across the full value chain, we
ensure the highest standards in food safety and operational performance while actively working to
reduce your environmental footprint.

[ [Women with orange handbag, holding Tetra Prisma Aseptic carton package] ][174]

#### Packaging

#### [Packaging][175]

[ Learn more⁠ ][176]
[ [Operators with tablet, processing plant] ][177]

#### Integrated solutions & equipment

#### [Integrated solutions & equipment][178]

[ Learn more⁠ ][179]
[ [Tetra Pak operators, maintenance service on filling machine] ][180]

#### Services

#### [Services][181]

[ Learn more⁠ ][182]
[ [White carton packages, Tetra Pak carton package portfolio] ][183]

#### Product innovation

#### [Product innovation][184]

[ Learn more⁠ ][185]

#### Automation and digital solutions

[ Learn more⁠ ][188]

### Where we support you

[cow icon]
[ Dairy ][189]

From white milk and flavoured milk to yoghurt and cream, tap into evolving consumer trends with a
partner that can help you stay ahead in the dairy industry.

[ice cream icon]
[ Ice Cream ][190]

From recipes and diverse flavours to product testing and new formats, we cover all aspects of ice
cream production for small and large-scale needs.

[Powder icon]
[ Powder ][191]

Discover integrated solutions, expertise and equipment for ingredient and nutritional powders and
powdered food and drinks.

[Beverage carton icon]
[ Food supplement and nutrition ][192]

This high-margin category includes products that provide additional nutrients to both healthy
consumers and those with dietary restrictions or medical conditions.

[beverage icon]
[ Juice, Nectar & Still drinks ][193]

Whether it’s adding fruit chunks, probiotics or more, we help you meet the latest consumer trends
with a wide range of offerings.

[cutlery icon]
[ Food ][194]

Get expert advice and optimised processing and packaging solutions for fruits, vegetables, baby
food, ready-made dishes, and more.

[chef's hat icon]
[ New Food ][195]

Explore how we’re advancing the potential of new food processes such as biomass, precision
fermentation, and meat cultivation.

[cheese icon]
[ Cheese ][196]

Harness our decades of industrial cheesemaking expertise, covering spreadable, fresh, semihard,
whey, and beyond.

[sprout icon]
[ Plant-based products ][197]

Access our global network of ingredient suppliers, state-of-the-art production lines, and packaging
options for oats, soya, peas, nuts rice, and more.

[beverage glass icon]
[ Other beverages ][198]

Whether it’s carbonated soft drinks, tea, or any other beverage, we have the know-how to help you
compete successfully.

[sustainability reports]

### Explore our latest
### Sustainability Report

We remain committed to driving more secure and sustainable food systems, while mitigating climate
impacts and improving the livelihoods of people across the world. Discover more about our progress
and achievements in 2025 in our latest report.
[ Explore the report⁠ ][199]

### Discover Tetra Pak

[ [Tetra Park workers smiling and talking] ][200]

#### Who we are

We’re here to make food safe and available. It’s why we provide advanced food production systems. 

[ Learn more about us⁠ ][201]
[ [three young people] ][202]

#### Come work with us

Curious about a career in the food industry? Joining Tetra Pak means becoming a valued part of a
global community of dedicated experts. Together, we're working to expand food access worldwide by
redefining the possibilities within food packaging and processing.

[ Explore careers at Tetra Pak⁠ ][203]
[hand holding a mobile phone]

### Contact Tetra Pak

Any questions or queries about our company, our product and solution offerings, career opportunities
or our sustainability approach? We are happy to answer your questions – please feel free to reach
out

## [Frequently Asked Questions][136]

#### How long will it take to receive my order?

95% of all orders are handed over to our shipping & logistics partners the very next working day
(within 24 hrs). Custom printed orders take an additional 3 days for artwork approval and CTP/plate
making. Majority of our orders are delivered within 2 days after shipment via Blue Dart, Delhivery,
India Post, etc. Remote locations and ones affected by lockdown may take longer.

#### What is your price for a bulk quantity order?

Please e-mail your request to sales@upack.in and we will be happy to provide a bulk quotation for
packaging materials, customised boxes, carton boxes, packing tapes, bubble roll, stretch film, etc.

#### Can you sell to individual customers or just to companies?

Although most of our sales are business to business, we can sell to any type of customer.

#### What other payment options?

You may use all major credit cards, net banking, UPI, etc. U-Pack’s payment gateway partners are
PCI/DSS certified to keep your transaction details confidential at all times.

#### Do I have to place my order online?

If you would prefer, we would be happy to take your order by phone (022) 4896 4040, or by e-mail at
sales@upack.in. However, you will receive your order fastest if you place it online. Online orders
are immediately sent to the warehouse to be picked and shipped.

#### Can I request of copy of my invoice or receipt?

We send your invoice along with the shipment. If you need another copy, simply e-mail us at
sales@upack.in and we will e-mail you a copy.

#### Is your website secure?

Yes. The security of our website and the protection of your personal information is extremely
important to us. U-Pack is deployed behind the world's foremost WAF (Web Application Firewall). You
can see a copy of our SSL Encryption Certificate simply by clicking on the padlock on the right side
of your browser. We have also partnered with external security providers to manually audit our data
periodically for beaches.

#### How do I know I can trust ordering from you?

U-Pack is GST registered company in Mumbai doing business since 2018 with several thousand happy
customers. Take a look at our 1000+ real customer reviews.

#### I have a coupon. How do I redeem it?

If you have a coupon that you would like to redeem, there is a place on the shopping cart page for
you to enter the coupon code in the checkout form.

#### How much do you charge for shipping?

Orders above ₹ 1500 will be shipped free of cost. For orders below ₹ 1500, a nominal fee of ₹ 149
would be applied. See our shipping policy page for full details.

#### Do you ship outside India?

At the present time, we do not ship outside India.

#### Can I stop by and pick up products at one of your local distribution centers?

In order to keep our prices low, our distribution centers are not staffed for direct customer
pick-up.

#### Is it possible to get samples?

We are happy to provide samples of any types of packaging, product packaging boxes and other packing
material whenever possible. Please e-mail us at support@upack.in and we will check to see if we have
sample stock available. You can also order samples online using the link in the footer.

## [Frequently Asked Questions][136]

#### How long will it take to receive my order?

95% of all orders are handed over to our shipping & logistics partners the very next working day
(within 24 hrs). Custom printed orders take an additional 3 days for artwork approval and CTP/plate
making. Majority of our orders are delivered within 2 days after shipment via Blue Dart, Delhivery,
India Post, etc. Remote locations and ones affected by lockdown may take longer.

#### What is your price for a bulk quantity order?

Please e-mail your request to sales@upack.in and we will be happy to provide a bulk quotation for
packaging materials, customised boxes, carton boxes, packing tapes, bubble roll, stretch film, etc.

#### Can you sell to individual customers or just to companies?

Although most of our sales are business to business, we can sell to any type of customer.

#### What other payment options?

You may use all major credit cards, net banking, UPI, etc. U-Pack’s payment gateway partners are
PCI/DSS certified to keep your transaction details confidential at all times.

#### Do I have to place my order online?

If you would prefer, we would be happy to take your order by phone (022) 4896 4040, or by e-mail at
sales@upack.in. However, you will receive your order fastest if you place it online. Online orders
are immediately sent to the warehouse to be picked and shipped.

#### Can I request of copy of my invoice or receipt?

We send your invoice along with the shipment. If you need another copy, simply e-mail us at
sales@upack.in and we will e-mail you a copy.

#### Is your website secure?

Yes. The security of our website and the protection of your personal information is extremely
important to us. U-Pack is deployed behind the world's foremost WAF (Web Application Firewall). You
can see a copy of our SSL Encryption Certificate simply by clicking on the padlock on the right side
of your browser. We have also partnered with external security providers to manually audit our data
periodically for beaches.

#### How do I know I can trust ordering from you?

U-Pack is GST registered company in Mumbai doing business since 2018 with several thousand happy
customers. Take a look at our 1000+ real customer reviews.

#### I have a coupon. How do I redeem it?

If you have a coupon that you would like to redeem, there is a place on the shopping cart page for
you to enter the coupon code in the checkout form.

#### How much do you charge for shipping?

Orders above ₹ 1500 will be shipped free of cost. For orders below ₹ 1500, a nominal fee of ₹ 149
would be applied. See our shipping policy page for full details.

#### Do you ship outside India?

At the present time, we do not ship outside India.

#### Can I stop by and pick up products at one of your local distribution centers?

In order to keep our prices low, our distribution centers are not staffed for direct customer
pick-up.

#### Is it possible to get samples?

We are happy to provide samples of any types of packaging, product packaging boxes and other packing
material whenever possible. Please e-mail us at support@upack.in and we will check to see if we have
sample stock available. You can also order samples online using the link in the footer.

## Secure. Authenticate. Control.

**Protecting Products, Documents, and Packaging from Counterfeiting, Diversion, and Fraud**

*VeriTrace combines diverse security print technologies and digital authentication Systems to
safeguard and verify products, protect sensitive documents, and maintain supply chain control.*

**ANSI/NASPO Certified** • **ISO 14298** **Certified** • **Secure U.S. Manufacturing**
* [VeriTrace Security Seal]

  Secure Paper
* [Securing Your Supply Chain with VeriTrace]
  Supply Chain Security

[VeriTrace Security Seal][Vital Records][Securing Your Supply Chain with VeriTrace]
[VeriTrace Government Solutions]

## Government Solutions

Birth Certificates, titles, official documents, and tax stamps must resist alteration, duplication,
and fraud.

Our intaglio and other security printing technologies combine tactile authentication with covert
anti-counterfeit features.

Excise Tax programs require strong anti-counterfeit protections to prevent revenue loss and illegal
distribution.

Immediate visual trust with layered forensic protection.

[Explore Government Solutions][41]
[Brand Protection Solutions by VeriTrace]

## Brand Protection

Counterfeiting, diversion, and warranty fraud can quietly erode revenue and damage brand trust.

VeriTrace provides tamper-evident labels, authentication codes, and track-and-trace systems that
enable brands to verify products at any point in the supply chain.

Know what’s real, where products move, and when something goes wrong.

[Explore Brand Protection][42]
[VeriTrace Digital UID Products]

## DIGITAL UID

Unit Identification

Digital identification systems connect products, packaging, and supply chains to real-time
authentication and tracking tools.

VeriTrace supports multiple system models, enabling companies to balance visibility, security, and
operational efficiency.

[Explore Digital UID][43]
[VeriTrace Label, Tape, and Seal Products]

## Labels, Tapes, Seals

Our custom multi-layered security solutions combine physical and digital technologies to deliver
real-world protection for products, parts, and assets throughout the supply chain.

[Explore Labels, Tapes, & Seals][44]
[VeriTrace Vital Records and Security Paper Products]

## VITAL RECORDS
## SECURITY PAPER

VeriTrace combines intaglio and other security printing technologies to help protect the integrity
of critical documents from counterfeiting, revenue loss, illegal distribution, and unauthorized
reproduction.

[Explore Vital Records][45]
[VeriTrace Tax Stamps]

## Tax Stamps

VeriTrace integrates a comprehensive portfolio of security printing, digital, and brand-protection
technologies into pressure-sensitive stamps.

[Explore Tax Stamps][46]
[VeriTrace Specialty Products]

## Specialty Products

VeriTrace produces distinctive specialty printed products using currency-grade intaglio printing and
layered security technologies.

These solutions are ideal for programs that require authenticity, collectability, and protection
against counterfeiting or unauthorized reproduction.

[Explore Specialty Products][47]
[VeriTrace Technology Solutions]

## Technologies

Our custom multi-layered security solutions combine physical and digital technologies to deliver
real-world protection for products, parts, and assets throughout the supply chain.

[Explore Technologies][48]

## The Difference Between “Secure” and “Certified Secure” Is Everything.

**Our ANSI/NASPO and ISO 14298 certifications, validated workflows, documented chain-of-custody
procedures, and strict quality controls help ensure every project remains secure from conception
through delivery.**

The cybersecurity platform for the AI Age - built on Zero Trust to protect users, workloads,
branches and devices through the world’s largest inline security cloud.

Embrace AI with confidence using Zscaler AI Protect, a unified solution to secure AI at scale.

Draw on insights from the world’s largest inline security cloud and third-party sources to assess
risk and detect and contain breaches.

Phishing is getting quieter and more dangerous. Although volume is down ~20% YoY, AI is accelerating

attack surfaces, validating stolen credentials, and executing account takeover inside encrypted
traffic.
